column1: # Guarantees the templates pin, one per line, read by both consumers:
# Tab-separated. TSV rather than JSON because --check runs in whatever repo the
# skill was pointed at, where jq is not guaranteed to exist.
# document  the installed file: issue-tracker, request (pull-request.md or
#           merge-request.md, whichever the forge got), or verification
# name      what a developer reads when it is missing
# pattern   case-insensitive extended regex, matched against the whole file
# origin    where in the template it comes from, so an agent can read the
#           original and adapt it to this repo
# A guarantee belongs here when the template pins it for every repo. A fact
# that varies by forge, by task, or by the language answer stays in the grader,
# which knows what it asked for.
